name: MuffinEMU Experimental (TrollStore)
subtitle: Unfinished test builds - TrollStore.
description: The most complete Wii U experience on iPhone and iPad. Your games, a real GamePad, your TV - every feature free, no paywalls, ever. These are unfinished test builds, published by hand to try out work in progress. Each one replaces an installed MuffinEMU: it has the same bundle identifier as the standard build, so your games, saves and settings carry over. They can crash or misbehave. For normal play use the Stable source instead. This one is the ad-hoc signed build, with the JIT entitlements embedded, for TrollStore and jailbroken devices.

apps.name: MuffinEMU Experimental
apps.subtitle: Wii U emulator - experimental TrollStore builds
apps.localizedDescription:
MuffinEMU is the most complete way to play Wii U on iPhone and iPad. Real games, a real GamePad, on the screen in your hand or the TV across the room. Every emulation feature is free. No paywalls, no subscriptions, no catch. Built on Cemu, tuned for every iPhone and iPad from iOS 15 up.

The app does not include games, keys or system files. Bring the games you own.

[A Library That Looks the Part]
- Drop in WUA, WUD/WUX, decrypted or encrypted dumps straight from Files. Updates and DLC install in the app
- HD box art finds itself, or add your own in up to 4K
- Cards, big covers, compact grid or list, with sorting, grouping, filters and renaming

[Serious Graphics]
- A Metal renderer built for Apple GPUs, plus Vulkan through MoltenVK
- Graphic packs and resolution scaling
- Bring your desktop Cemu shader caches and skip the stutter

[Speed]
- Plays out of the box on the interpreter
- Flip on JIT with StikDebug or LiveContainer for the full-speed recompiler. MuffinEMU asks for you at launch

[The GamePad, Done Right]
- An on-screen GamePad measured from the real thing, with skins, an analog stick and a full layout editor
- Hardware controllers work right alongside it
- One screen, both screens, iPhone portrait, or the TV image on an external display

[Online]
- Pretendo Network with your own Wii U account files
- Custom servers: import a network_services.xml or type the addresses

[Yours to Tune]
- Basic and Advanced settings, per-game settings and one-tap settings backup
- 31 app icons with matching themes

Free, open source, and updated constantly. This is Wii U on iOS the way it should be.

Official Site: https://muffinemu.github.io/MuffinSite-Remastered/
Guides: https://muffinemu.github.io/MuffinEMU/docs/
Source code: https://github.com/MuffinEMU/Muffin-EMU
Report a problem: https://github.com/MuffinEMU/Muffin-EMU/issues

Legal

MuffinEMU is not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple. Wii U is a trademark of Nintendo. No copyrighted games, keys or firmware are distributed here.

versions.localizedDescription:
Experiment: Save states (same-session loads)
Branch: feature/save-states-stage0
Commit: 1a9129e
Based on: main `492ce96` (v7.2), plus 3 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-06 20:20 UTC

- Loading a save state now tells you exactly why it was refused, with an error code, and only says "loaded" once the game is drawing again.
- Loading a save state brings the graphics back in step with the restored game, and no longer gives up when the game is waiting on the screen to refresh.
- Loading a save state works after the game has started or stopped background tasks, and timers and sleeping threads carry on from where they were.

Experiment: Favour performance
Branch: feature/favour-performance
Commit: 5598a43
Based on: main `fd4fadf` (v6.7), plus 50 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-06 01:14 UTC

- Reset settings to defaults now also resets moved on-screen buttons and the Preview pad, and Let MuffinEMU choose again on the Emulated Clock now really returns to automatic.
- Settings sections are reordered so related options sit together and About is last.
- Playing Splatoon no longer turns on the on-screen sticks and the two-screen layout for your other games.
- Game options now show what each setting follows, say when changes apply, and can be reset to the global defaults in one tap.
- The performance overlay and notification text colour is now chosen with a colour picker instead of a hex code you could not type.
- Settings wording is clearer about what each option does and when it applies, and MoltenVK only shows when Vulkan is selected.
- Settings now explains why Account and Network Service are dimmed during a game, and when the Preview pad is being overridden by another control style.
- The Theme row in Settings now shows which theme is active, and the locked pro icon message points to Settings > Premium.
- The TV and GamePad volume sliders now work, including while a game is running.
- Turning on only VRAM usage or Debug in the overlay now shows it.
- Pausing, switching apps and saving a state no longer step on each other. A game no longer keeps running in the background after you leave m...
